description:
What is This Part?
This is the Rubber Covers that goes over the metal foot plate on the Clutch and Brake Pedals
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, Clutch
Qty 1 – Cover, Brake
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
